meta.title: Prompt enhancer
meta.description: Adds a one-click prompt-enhance button to the composer tool row beside the model selector: it rewrites the draft prompt into a clearer, more complete, directly executable version, keeps the original intent and language, and returns only the enhanced prompt.

action.empty: Type something first: the composer is empty
action.unavailable: Prompt enhancer is unavailable in this composer
error.network: Cannot reach the prompt enhancement service. Check that it is running
error.empty_result: The model returned no usable prompt. Try again
settings.title: Prompt enhancer
settings.description: Set the direction the rewrite should follow. These keywords shape the tone, register, and level of detail of every enhanced prompt. Leave the box empty to keep the default behaviour.
settings.keywordsPlaceholder:
e.g.
concise
formal tone
beginner friendly
settings.keywordsHint: Keywords affect how the prompt is written, never what it asks for: they cannot add a technology or a requirement the original text did not mention.
settings.loadFailed: Could not read the saved keywords
settings.noChanges: No unsaved changes: the box already matches what is stored
settings.modelHint: The model prompt enhancement runs on. Independent of the agent's own model selection.
